paper.displayName: Butter paper · page surface, not Paper ink

stamp.displayName: Deep persimmon · page accent, not card coral

night.displayName: Petrol page alias · not Midnight ink

display.purpose: Noto Serif Bengali global page headings, 34–54px; not the home welcome. The same face carries card quotes, book titles, and wordmarks.

welcome.purpose: Noto Serif Bengali, 20–28px, weight 500 and 1.4 leading; normal tracking.

featured-book.purpose: Noto Serif Bengali, 22–30px on desktop, 18–20px on mobile; weight 600.

section.purpose: Global sections use 24–31px; home shelf headings use 28px and reader-feed headings remain 24px.

body.purpose: Manrope/Anek Bangla at 16px for body and ordinary fields; header search is 15px desktop, 16px mobile. All three local OFL faces remain at 400/500/600.

metadata.purpose: Vertical spine titles use 14/16/18px; horizontal authors use 13px (14px Bengali), years 12px. Normal tracking; card metadata follows shared measured geometry.

shadows.name: object
shadows.value: 0 4px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 12%, transparent), 10px 22px 30px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Shared --shadow-object vocabulary; featured volumes and shelf spines also use scoped contact shadows.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Detached petrol rail; the intentional UI exception to artwork shadows.

shadows.name: featured-line
shadows.value: 0 6px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 15%, transparent), 0 22px 38px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 20%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Depth around the featured card, never a replacement for canonical inks or geometry.

motion.name: ease-ambient
motion.purpose: Bounded closed-volume and decorative-field motion only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Standard interface and drawer transitions; drawer transitions stop under reduced motion.

motion.name: paired-slide
motion.purpose: One keyed book/line pair, wait-mode enter/exit, no initial hiding. Reduced motion removes slide travel and retains a short fade.

motion.name: idle-rotation
motion.purpose: Stops for hover, focus/manual selection, pause, open drawer, hidden/offscreen state, or reduced motion. Manual interaction keeps motion paused until resumed.

motion.name: closed-volume
motion.purpose: Separate preserve-3d cover/back/spine/page planes turn only while the carousel is rotating.

motion.name: cloth-field
motion.purpose: Decorative color field follows the active cloth; its loop shares rotation gates and is removed on compact mobile.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: Discrete ownership press, not ambient motion; disabled by reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: A clear next action with a 44px touch target; petrol on warm paper.

components.name: Reading-room writing action
components.description: Persimmon writing action in the featured petrol line field; canonical card coral is unchanged.

components.name: Text field
components.description: Readable editable text, never a placeholder-only label.
components.html: <label for="ds-line">Your line</label><input id="ds-line" class="ds-field" placeholder="What stayed with you?">

components.name: Genre filter
components.description: Soft-filled 44px pill; selection uses petrol and raised-paper text, not a category color.

components.name: Floating navigation rail
components.description: Collapsed-rail state excerpt. Production rail is 72px inside a 96px gutter, or 208px inside 232px expanded, fixed 12px left and 16px top/bottom at 1024px and above. Physical book-plane radii (1–4px) are separate from this 22px UI radius.

components.name: Carousel motion control
components.description: Running-state specimen. One localized carousel control beside the compact headline manages in-memory pause/resume and disables under live reduced motion. Focus/manual selection pauses until resumed; rotation and decorative loops share hover, drawer, and visibility gates.

narrative.northStar: A book becomes a personal keepsake
narrative.overview:
Carried is an energetic nostalgic bilingual reading room: compact header search, a small headline, one paired book-and-line carousel, a dense full-width cloth-spine shelf, then reader lines. A real closed 3D cover volume and its matching line share a changing cloth-color field. The rejected sparse covers, giant welcome, cutout bookcase, and whole-page 56/44 split are historical, not active requirements. The floating rail and approved page palette remain.

Noto Serif Bengali remains the display voice, with Manrope/Anek Bangla for the interface, all locally hosted OFL faces at 400/500/600. The former Fraunces/Plex letterpress fonts, sepia treatment, and wide tracking stay superseded; licensing history remains in docs/design/modern-bangla-typography.md. Original card inks, payloads, and edition IDs stay intact while all renderers adopt the approved open Bookplate and simpler Poster/Ticket furniture.
keyCharacteristics: Floating 72/208px rail inside 96/232px gutters; one document scroll, not permanent page sectors.
Compact header search shares URL q/genre state with the shelf via carried:search and popstate.
One active book/line pair; 9-second idle rotation with pause, manual, reduced-motion, visibility, and drawer gates.

Dense shelf starts at 20 books on home and 24 on /books; no carousel on /books. Tracks are at least 148px with 16px column gaps and 260–316px spines; titles use 14/16/18px with horizontal author/year below.
Compact mobile shows full quote and name; lazy modal drawer supplies canonical card, Save/share, and real routes.
Unchanged butter-paper, petrol, persimmon, and pistachio page tokens; immutable card inks inside the artwork.

rules.name: Artifact parity
rules.body: DOM, 1080×1350 PNG, and 1200×630 landscape OG share content decisions and measured layout. Bookplate is open and left-aligned without an outer certificate frame; Poster/Ticket retain simpler edition-specific furniture. Measure the complete author/publication-year byline and ownership before allocating quote space; preserve full content, dense clearances, ink/edition IDs, and legacy payload identity.

rules.name: The Artifact Boundary Rule
rules.body: Page tokens never recolor collectible artwork. All values in src/lib/inks.ts remain unchanged for paper, midnight, and moss, including text, rules, and coral ownership marks. Moss stays pale sage. Page Paper/Petrol are not card Paper/Midnight, and there is no fourth ink.

rules.name: Interaction dependencies
rules.body: Motion 14.12.0 supplies paired enter/exit; Base UI 1.9.0 supplies the lazy modal drawer with close/Escape, focus containment and return focus. Both lockfile entries are MIT-licensed. No new accounts, tracking, or persistence.

dos: Keep digital creation, every ink/edition, downloads, and sharing free.
Preserve line identity, measured publication-year credit, reader signatures, local shelves, and concept-cart contents.
Use actual canonical artwork in the drawer, exports, and merchandise mockups; keep its portrait proportions.
Keep full bilingual content, readable horizontal shelf metadata, visible focus, and 44px action targets.
Keep real route anchors, truthful editorial/live status, and content available without animation.
Keep rotation pauseable and the dense shelf still; source or code checks are not visual acceptance.
donts: Do not add accounts, tracking, locale cookies, or private server-side customer data; public sharing remains distinct from the local personal shelf.
Do not restore sparse cover grids, giant home headlines, cutout bookcase scenery, or the whole-page split.
Do not add gradients, glass, grain, fake statistics, invented profiles, or social-proof placeholders.
Do not recolor Paper/Midnight/Moss with page tokens or introduce a fourth ink.
Do not gate reading behind animation or replace mobile quotes with tiny full cards.
Do not add prices, checkout, orders, or delivery promises to the concept shop.
Do not treat public cover access, editorial reflections, translations, art, or reader submissions as commercial merchandise clearance.
